text:
sam: Heads-up: v2->v3 header cut scheduled Mon 05:00 UTC. A handful of large tenants still send X-Old-Auth. Need a short, operational plan: how long do we accept the old header, what shim, telemetry gates, and an emergency kill-switch.
anya: +1 on a short plan. My proposal: 2-week grandfathering window per-tenant with a feature-flag to enforce. Router-level shim that translates X-Old-Auth -> Authorization for compat.
luke: Router shim is fine but avoid per-request DB lookups. Keep it in-process with a small LRU and a Redis-backed fallback for per-tenant toggles. Also add a circuit breaker so the shim doesn't add tail latency.
maria: Telemetry: emit an "old_header_accepted" counter with tenant_id tag. Sample 1% of request bodies for diffing. Alert if any tenant > 5000 req/day using old header after day 7.
sam: Rollout path suggestion: Canary (10%) -> 50% -> 100% for shim only. After 2 weeks, flip enforcement behind ops toggle: if enforcement enabled, requests with old header get 426 + migration doc link.
luke: Implementation detail: add an ops toggle "compat_hotswap" exposed in console and as k8s annotation for router pods. Fast path in router: if compat_hotswap=false and header missing Authorization then return 426. If true, translate header. Also keep a short cache TTL (5m) for header translations.
anya: Router config snippet (pseudo):
```
- match: header X-Old-Auth
  action: translate_header(X-Old-Auth -> Authorization)
  cache_ttl: 5m
```
Keep it config driven so we can opt tenants out.
maria: Keep tenant opt-in state in Redis (ephemeral) so we can expire and backfill without schema changes. Prometheus metrics for counts + histogram for shim latency. I'll draft alert rules: old_header_rate > 5000 for 24h -> PagerDuty.
sam: Owners & next steps: Anya + Maria draft migration doc & tenant email; Luke owns router change + bench; Ops to own toggling and executing enforcement. Can we aim to have docs + runbook by Friday?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for "router-shim-v1" — 10% traffic on infra-router-prod.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll write the doc and put client-snippets in it. Also recommend we send a deprecation email to tenants in the 2-week window.
luke: I'll run latency + qps bench. Preliminary local bench showed ~0.8ms p95 overhead; need to confirm at scale so we don't breach p95 SLO.
maria: Draft PR with prometheus rule and sample Grafana panel linked. Will post PR link in this thread when ready.
sam: TL;DR: canary, telemetry, docs/emails, emergency toggle. Timeline: doc by Fri, monitor through weekend, enforcement flip after 2-week window with ops kill-switch. Thanks all.
